programmes.d: The SWAT team must recover DNA evidence kits stolen from a crime lab and bring in the crew responsible; financial strain at home makes it difficult for Deacon to focus on his role as leader of the SWAT division's annual holiday toy drive.

The team faces difficult reminders of a past school shooting when they receive a warning that a copycat plans to re-enact the crime; as the team races to stop the new threat, they flash back to the day of the tense first mission.

Jessica and Chris go undercover in Mexico to save a Mexican federal agent who has been kidnapped by a drug-dealing gang that Jessica helped bring to justice; Hondo's mother worries about him when he engages in renovation projects in her home.

The team races to find a militant group that escaped capture months earlier; now, the criminals take hostages in exchange for a $500 million ransom from corporations they deem corrupt; Hondo's emotional turmoil begins to affect his leadership.

Hondo reunites with an old flame when the SWAT team works with the FBI to bring in a separatist group that has weapons-grade plutonium; the team worries it will lose an annual law enforcement charity competition to the Los Angeles Fire Department.

The SWAT team pursues a group of unknown assailants responsible for a patrol officer's death; Chris reels from the revelation that she knew the patrol officer who was killed; Deacon and his wife prepare to welcome their newest child.

The SWAT team struggles to maintain peace on the eve of an LGBTQ pride festival after a hate crime sparks citywide anger that ignites further violence; Hicks reunites with his estranged gay son; Street worries his mother will be sent back to prison.

The SWAT team tries to zero in on the next target of a carjacking ring that's using deadly force to boost luxury vehicles; Hondo takes a big step to help his childhood friend's incarcerated son; Mumford weighs a major decision.

Hondo has a tense reunion with a fellow Marine, Ruiz, when the team hunts an escaped convict who was broken out of prison by criminals using stolen military weapons; Chris prepares for a difficult goodbye when her former K-9 partner becomes ill.
